title: Record the even source-call count on overlapping windows
body:
## Summary
- Consecutive length-two windows through ten outputs have hitting number `ceil(k/2)`, and the even source-call count is twice that number rounded up.
- Prices `(1, 9, 1)` cost 6; one shared-slot call plus an outside close costs 14, and two shared-slot calls cost 22.
- The six-output scalar pilot uses 70 gates, the disjoint windows use 84, and the per-output close uses 126. The selected κ is unchanged.
